subject: Mid-quarter course correction: decisions needed for QBR readout
messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: OptiCloud - Sarah Li <sarah.li@opticloud.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mid-quarter course correction: decisions needed for QBR readout

Team —

Attached is the mid-quarter readout deck and a short QBR request form (attached). I want a concise set of decisions we can put on the exec QBR slide so we aren’t debating this in the review. High-level snapshot:

- Velocity / outcome: Feature rollout for Adaptive Routing is behind target (~60% of planned PVs). Risk to QBR commitment if we don’t unblock infra and prioritization.
- Cost / unit economics: Token cost has spiked 14% QoQ due to expanded inference fallbacks. Ops has mitigation options but needs Dedicated capacity increase or tighter routing rules.
- Customer impact: OptiCloud POC is asking to move timeline two weeks earlier if we can guarantee a 99th-p90 latency SLA.

Decisions I need by EOD Wednesday (2026-11-04):
1) Approve a +1 Dedicated GPU pool (3x A100 slices) for Adaptive Routing canary through Nov. 30 — finance tradeoff is a +$48k monthly run-rate.
2) Prioritize infra bugfixes (INF-472 / INF-489) over less critical telemetry work for two sprints.
3) Signoff for limited-term SLA extension language for OptiCloud (legal has draft but needs exec OK on term length).

Dependencies / asks:
- Laura: please validate the revised cost model slide and confirm whether the Dedicated uplift covers projected 2-week acceleration for OptiCloud.
- Vanessa: can you propose the resource trade (which FE or infra tickets get bumped) and flag any headcount needs?
- Markus: need a quick green light on the Dedicated pool commit or an alternative routing policy we can push to prod.

I’ve proposed two 30-minute decision calls if we need synchronous alignment: Wed 9:00 or Wed 3:00 PT. If we can all lock decisions async that’s fine — put changes into slide 8 (decision ledger) and ping me.

Attachments: midq-readout-deck.pptx, QBR_request_form.pdf

Thanks —
Michael Grant
VP, Product
Redwood Inference

On Mon, Nov 2, 2026 at 8:12 AM Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team — Attached is the mid-quarter readout deck and a short QBR request form (attached). I want a concise set of decisions we can put on the exec QBR slide so we aren’t debating this in the review.

Thanks Michael — quick updates from Product metrics: I ran the revised cost sims and the Dedicated uplift (3x A100 slices) reduces p50/p90 token cost by ~9% for our projected distribution; it does enable the 2-week acceleration for OptiCloud assuming no additional feature scope creep. I attached a one-page with the updated numbers (slide 6 replacement).

Two callouts:
- Data retention/security: the OptiCloud POC requires a 90-day KV cache retention exception for traceability. Security will need to sign that off (I can loop in Mina but need a list of exact artifacts they want).
- Instrumentation: If we triage INF-472 now, we can get a measurable latency improvement in the next ship; INF-489 has lower impact and can be deferred if teams agree.

I can be on the 3:00 PT sync and will add the updated slide to Drive (linked).

Laura Bennett
Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

> Thanks Michael — quick updates from Product metrics...

Agree with Michael and Laura — we should approve the Dedicated pool for a short pilot to de-risk the OptiCloud ask. Two notes from an ops/resource perspective:

- I can free up two engineer-weeks from the telemetry backlog by deprioritizing metric refactors; that gets us to INF-472 triage without hiring.
- To run the Dedicated pilot we need a temporary reassignment: move one infra engineer (infra-anna) from SecOps to the serving team Nov 8–21. I'll need Markus to OK the reallocation and to sign off on the fallback resource plan if urgent SecOps incidents surface.

Action items I’m adding to the decision ledger (slide 8):
* Approve Dedicated pilot (Nov 8–30) — Vanessa to execute resource swaps.
* INF-472 triage prioritized for Nov 8 sprint.
* Laura to coordinate with Security (Mina) for cache-retention exception artifacts.

I’m attaching a short exec one-pager with the ask and the fallback plan (exec-resource-onepager.pdf).

Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Customer Solutions
Redwood Inference

Thanks for the detailed note and the deck — appreciate the fast turnaround. OptiCloud can prioritize the POC timeline if Redwood can guarantee the pilot capacity and a short SLA addendum for the POC window. Two practical items from procurement:

1) We need the updated QBR_request_form filled (I attached a procurement template) and a named technical contact for the pilot (we'll use Vanessa as primary).
2) Term ask: a limited 30-day SLA addendum is acceptable for the POC but procurement requires a liability cap alignment in the contract appendix.

If those items are clear, we can shift our engineering resources to start integration testing on Nov 10 and aim to complete the POC by Nov 24.

Best,
Sarah Li
Director, Strategic Partnerships
OptiCloud Inc.
